title: Outlook: new Copilot entry point in classic Outlook
summary: The briefing accurately reports the roadmap and Microsoft's rollout notice, including default availability and unchanged licensing requirements. The licence-assignment path and Microsoft Graph operation are documented; the API pre-check finding was a text-matching artefact.

claims.claim: The notice and roadmap describe no new permission or identity requirement.
claims.quote: Searched: supplied roadmap description and full MC1441784 for permissions and identity requirements; neither specifies a new requirement. The notice states no existing licensing requirements or admin settings change.

claims.claim: The roadmap and notice do not describe actions running without user selection.
claims.quote: Searched: supplied roadmap description and full MC1441784 for autonomous actions; the notice describes users acting on suggestions with a single click, with no unattended action described.

claims.claim: The roadmap and notice attach no meter to the entry-point update.

claims.claim: The roadmap does not suggest a price or credit rate is planned for this entry point.
claims.quote: Searched: full supplied roadmap description for pricing, credits and metering; it describes a consistent entry point and relevant actions, not a planned charge.

claims.claim: A price or credit rate specific to this entry point is not published.
claims.quote: Searched: "Copilot" "classic Outlook" "price" "entry"; "Outlook" "Copilot" "entry point" price credit rate data hide policy. Opened Copilot licence options and usage-based billing overview; no entry-point-specific price or rate found.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Microsoft does not describe new data access for this entry point or whether its recommendations use data beyond the existing side pane.
claims.quote: Searched: "Copilot" "contextual recommendations" Outlook data; "classic Outlook" "entry point" "recommendations". Read requirements, notice and release-note excerpts; broader Chat and personalization features do not specify this entry point's data comparison.

claims.claim: The notice names no setting specifically for the entry point.
claims.quote: Searched: full supplied MC1441784 for an entry-point setting; it states existing admin settings are unchanged and no action is required, without naming a setting to configure.

claims.claim: The notice does not describe Copilot licence assignment as a way to hide the entry point.
claims.quote: All users with Copilot license and enterprise license users (with or without Copilot license) will see the new DAB.

claims.claim: Microsoft 365 admin center > Billing > Licenses > product > Assign licenses reaches licence assignment.
claims.quote: In the admin center, go to the Billing > Licenses page. Select a product. On the product details page, select Assign licenses.

claims.claim: POST /v1.0/users/{id | userPrincipalName}/assignLicense assigns or removes user licences through Microsoft Graph.
claims.quote: user: assignLicense - Microsoft Graph v1.0. Add or remove licenses for the user to enable or disable their use of Microsoft cloud offerings. POST /users/{id | userPrincipalName}/assignLicense

claims.claim: The assignLicense request body takes addLicenses.
claims.quote: addLicenses | assignedLicense collection | A collection of assignedLicense objects that specify the licenses to add.

claims.claim: The assignLicense request body takes removeLicenses.
claims.quote: removeLicenses | Guid collection | A collection of skuIds that identify the licenses to remove. Required. Can be an empty collection.

claims.claim: Assigning licences in the admin center requires at least License Administrator or User Administrator.
claims.quote: You must be at least a License or User Administrator to assign licenses.

claims.claim: Microsoft recommends informing users that the classic Outlook Copilot entry point is moving.
claims.quote: We recommend that you: Inform users that the Copilot entry point in classic Outlook is moving to a new location.
